episodes.title: Nobody claps at 5 AM

scenes.vo: Five A.M. Nobody's watching. Nobody's clapping.
No crowd. No likes. Just you, a lamp, and a promise nobody else knows about.
Day one, nothing changes. Day thirty, nothing changes. Day ninety, still nothing.
Then day ninety one, it finally shows. And everyone calls it luck.
It was never luck. It was ninety mornings nobody clapped for.

episodes.title: Same 24 hours

scenes.vo: Two people. Same twenty four hours. Same phone in the pocket.
One scrolls until midnight. The other builds, one hour at a time.
One percent a day looks like nothing. For a whole month, it looks like nothing.
But a year later, you won't believe they started in the same place.
So which one are you going to be today?

episodes.title: Get up anyway

scenes.vo: You fell. And everyone saw it happen.
What they didn't see is you getting back up. Again, and again.
The weight never gets lighter. You get stronger.
The easy road was right there. You looked at it. And chose the hard one.
That's it. That's the whole secret. Get up anyway.

episodes.title: Just two minutes

scenes.vo: Can't make yourself start? Good. Then don't try to finish.
Two minutes. Two pushups. Two pages. Two lines of code.
Two minutes becomes ten. Ten becomes a habit. And the habit does the rest.
Quietly, those tiny habits are building the person you want to be.
Start small. But start now.

episodes.title: Make future you proud

scenes.vo: Somewhere ahead of you, there's a version of you who made it.
Every choice today is a vote. For him, or against him.
The couch, or the gym. The scroll, or the book. He's counting.
He isn't waiting at the top. He's built on every single step.
So make him proud.

scenes.vo: Midnight. Everyone's asleep. The lamp is still on.
Nobody sees the pushing. They only see the top, and call you lucky.
So stop announcing it. Work in silence.
And let your results make all the noise.

episodes.title: Motivation leaves

scenes.vo: Motivation shows up when it feels like it. And leaves when it doesn't.
Discipline shows up at five A.M. when nothing feels good.
One waits to feel ready. One just starts. Ready never comes.
And day by day, the gap between them gets huge.
